name: gorelo-plugin
description: Work with your Gorelo PSA/RMM tenant from Claude: tickets, clients, assets, projects, time, uptime and billing. Community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Gorelo.

api_key.title: Gorelo API key
api_key.description: Create one in Gorelo under Settings > API. Scope it to match the access tier below.

region.title: Gorelo region
region.description: Where your Gorelo data is hosted: usw (US) or aue (Australia).

access_tier.title: Access tier
access_tier.description: read: look only. write: tickets, comments, time, uptime, draft invoices. full: also deletes, approved invoices and catalogue items.
